  "pros": [
    "Highly customizable and flexible for various workflows",

    "Intuitive drag-and-drop for tasks and reordering",
    "Good for collaboration and team management"

  "cons": [
    "Can be overwhelming and complex due to too many features",
    "Performance issues, often slow or buggy at times",
    "Cluttered or confusing user interface, especially for new users",
    "Steep learning curve due to extensive options and settings",
    "Inconsistent UI/UX design across different features or views",
    "Notifications can be excessive or poorly managed"
  ],
  "overall_rating": 3.5
}
